mechanism: Concrete datagen day/night rituals consume bound Djinni activation plus4 typed ingredients into one owned worker with registered day_time/night_time factory. Actual GoldenBowl tick consumes extracted inputs to consumedIngredients then finishes summon. SpiritEntity nests job factoryId+currentChangeTicks+snapshot requiredChangeTicks+newTime; factory decoder creates correct concrete job. Server first aiStep calls init and then update while alive. Worker increments restored elapsed counter and directly interpolates authoritative server OVERWORLD clock toward next dawn/nightfall, dividing remaining time by remaining work ticks. At exact completed counter it dies/removes. This is a post-payment one-shot continuous global clock transformation obligation, not cached UI progress or a recast permission. Whole lifecycle max1; day/night/queued weather/base factory/helpers support0.
actual_payment: GoldenBowl.activate server branch inserts activation resource, shrinks player held1 then commits (insertion result not checked there). Each additional cost extracts1 from matched bowl in transaction and appends extracted copy. Finished branch invokes recipe.finish first then attempts extraction of activation slot. SummonRitual also shrinks temporary activationItem passed to finish, sets owner/tame, creates concrete job/init/setJob, and unchecked world spawn. Not strict atomic prepaid result generation.
critical_reload_limit: ChangeTimeJob reader does restore newTime, but init/onInit always immediately overwrites it with getNewTime derived from CURRENT global clock. isInitialized defaults false and is not in writer. currentChangeTicks and frozen required duration remain; getNearestDayTime chooses STRICTLY NEXT occurrence, even at exact dawn. Therefore only remaining work fraction/config duration is retained; chosen absolute output deadline is not reliably retained. Repeated reload could change intended target, especially intervening world clock mutation. Do not claim original sampled target has survived.
other_limits: Equality completion check after increment, not>=: missing requiredChangeTicks->0 or current>=required may never finish normally. Both default elapsed/required0, no bounds/overflow checks. updateTime clamps remaining work denominator>=1, not a substitute for completion guard.

newTime and currentTime are global OVERWORLD clock even worker inhabits another dimension. No oldForge1.20.1 dayTime-equivalence claim; pinned code uses modernNeoForge WorldClocks/clockManager. Clock manager internal implementation and current Dynasty runtime not audited.

onInit if disabled immediately finishes/deletes paid worker without refund; actual update can continuecounter when config toggledfalse and finishes at exactduration, effect suppressed. No durable cancelled/refunded receipt.
Summon with job calls job.init before setJob; first entity init calls job.init again. Cleanup merely particles. No game/sound or source functions executed.

Spawn success ignored; completed worker death/remove and clock effects are not an atomic transaction with original bowls/entity save. Concurrent workers can overwrite same clock; no authored arbitration/owner lock seen.
